fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Detached Structure; Walkway; Landscaped Area; Access Drive
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Large Parking Area; Multiple Structures
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Mark the access point to the detached structure clearly so responders can locate it quickly at night or in low visibility.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles so responding units can reach both the main residence and the detached structure without repositioning.
• Confirm that gates or barriers along the access drive can be opened quickly from outside the property.
• Keep walkways between the main residence and detached structure clear of obstacles to allow responders to move between structures on foot.
• Trim landscaping along the access drive that may obstruct the path or reduce visibility for approaching vehicles.
• Mark utility shutoffs on both the main residence and the detached structure so responders can locate them without searching.
• Keep the large parking area surface clear of stored materials to allow responding units to stage, turn around, and reposition freely.

wildfire.conditions: Open Terrain; Scattered Trees; Scattered Shrubs; Vegetation Near Structure; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Multiple Access Routes; Open Green Space
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs that are growing directly next to the house to increase open space between plants and the structure.
• Remove any dead branches or dry plant material from shrubs near the house.
• Thin scattered trees close to the structure so their branches do not touch or hang over the roof or walls.
• Keep low branches on nearby trees trimmed up from the ground to reduce how easily fire can climb into the tree canopy.
• Clear any fallen leaves, twigs, or dry debris that has collected against the base of the house or along foundation edges.
• Maintain the open green space areas by mowing or cutting back vegetation before it dries out seasonally.
• Keep all access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching shrubs so vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
